label: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA: invented readings for exploring the workflow. Not measurements and not Chris's work.

session.title: Idle versus light load (synthetic walkthrough)
session.concept: Power is a rate and energy is a total: a run that draws more power for the same time transfers more energy.
session.task: Walk through one complete lab session with invented readings: choose the task, load two runs, save, reload, compare them, link the evidence to a claim and complete it.
checklist: Page reloaded and the work was still there
Runs compared and the warnings read
Evidence linked to a one-line claim
